purpose: Learned fast write projection plus native read ports on source pages observed before a later query; controls and persisted-image reload separate wiring from delayed-use benefit.
parent_role: E2 extension initialization and regression reference; fast write/read parameters are fresh.

training.feature_producer: frozen native input-token embeddings of the observed source page
training.write_schedule: one observed source page -> one deferred commit; query/action never enters the write
training.loss: response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked
training.selection: empty record bank; only the committed fast state supplies the observation

evaluation.metric: exact stripped answer; raw generated token IDs and answers retained
evaluation.restart: persist the first held-out observation image, load it into a fresh FastMemorySession, and compare the generated answer/state digest

decision_rule.accept: correct held-out exact accuracy strictly above shuffled, zero and disabled controls, with dev not below disabled
decision_rule.reject: no positive held-out gain or dev regression

stop_conditions: no held-out correct-state answer at update 32
retention: Keep parent extension, candidate extension, raw prompts/answers, persisted fast image and failure evidence. No base copy or download.
claims: Learned read-side delayed use on synthetic source pages; fixed token-embedding writer; no general memory or personal-fidelity claim.
